title: Chase, Do Not Capture
setup: The bishop on e5 hangs to your knight, and the knight on c6 is the one piece holding everything together.
hint: A defender forced to move is a defender you have removed. Which pawn can walk up and attack it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b5}} hits the knight, and every square it can reach abandons e5 — then {{Nxe5}}. If Black saves the bishop instead, {{bxc6}} takes the knight. Driving a guard away costs you nothing at all.
